jamie_release: Hold traffic at 25% for another 10m until rerank check is resolved. If rerank delta > 5% we'll rollback.
alex_product: Noted. If rerank is user-visible, we should open a quick rollback plan. Keeping flags off.
taylor_qa: Rerank discrepancy traced to tokenization edge case in downstream preproc — not related to model. Marking as false positive, continuing smoke.\amie_release: (typo in prior) All good, proceeding.
